clue: Fabulous cane with diamonds on top. Disco!
explanation: DANCE: disco! (To dance may be to disco.) ANCE (fabulous CANE) with D (diamonds) at the start (on top).
hints: How can we make CANE fabulous?
Diamonds is a playing card suit, and can be represented by the letter D.
That D goes "on top" (at the start).
Our answer will be a verb that can mean "disco"!
